title: fix(spec): the generated upgrade guide keeps a surface in one code span when it carries its own backticks
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiEosMC3zDfHaauURHFNq1GJ)_

Fixes #27532

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:协议升级指南生成器把每个条目的 `surface` 按 CommonMark 规则包进一个代码段(围栏比内部最长反引号串多一个),转换表单元格另外转义 `|`;两处渲染点共用一个入口,516 条条目一条未手改。
- **为什么改**:旧写法用单反引号包 `surface`,而 183 条语义条目在 `surface` 里自带反引号,渲染出来是代码与正文交替的碎片;两条带 `|` 的转换条目会把表格行撕成 6 格。
- **风险与回滚**:只动生成脚本与生成产物(随包发布的 `protocol-upgrade-guide.md` 与文档站页面),不动 schema、取值、错误码;不含反引号的 `surface` 字节不变。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`packages/spec/scripts/lib/markdown-code-span.ts`(围栏与补空格规则)→ `packages/spec/scripts/build-upgrade-guide.ts` 的 `tableRow` / `surfaceSpan` 两处调用 → `packages/spec/scripts/upgrade-guide-surface-span.test.ts` 的真实条目集钉子。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run scripts/upgrade-guide-surface-span.test.ts`,预期 15 个测试全绿;把任一渲染点改回单反引号再跑,预期变红。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地(等契约复审)。

Fable review: not run — the account's Fable quota is exhausted; the PR waits for the contract review (maintainer, 2026-10-29).

## What changes

- `packages/spec/scripts/lib/markdown-code-span.ts` (new): `codeSpan(text)` fences a one-line text with a backtick string one longer than the longest backtick run inside it, and pads one space on each side when the text starts or ends with a backtick or a space. That is CommonMark §6.1's own rule for code that contains backticks. A text with no backtick and no edge space comes out byte-identical to the old single-backtick span. A blank or multi-line text is refused, and the refusal names the entry. `readCodeSpan` is the reading half of the same rule; only the pin uses it.
- `packages/spec/scripts/build-upgrade-guide.ts`: both render sites (the conversion table row and the semantic list item) go through one `surfaceSpan(id, surface)` door. The conversion row is built by `tableRow`, which escapes `|` in every cell. GFM ends a cell at an unescaped pipe even inside a code span, and two live conversion surfaces carry one (`navigation-mode-overlay-values-removed`, `form-view-presentation-types-removed`).
- **Why a longer fence and not prose:** a surface is a key path or an expression, and it reads as code. Rendering it as prose would make the guide's two forms of one surface differ from what `migrate meta` prints. A longer fence keeps one code span per surface and shows the author's backticks literally. No entry is edited.
- `18.visibility-predicate-has-argument-refused.ts`: the workaround note ("no backticks in `surface`") is dropped. Its surface is untouched.
- `export-job-family-retirement.test.ts`, `package-upgrade-family-retirement.test.ts`: each drops one `expect(entry!.surface).not.toMatch(/BACKTICK/)` line. Those lines forbade backticks in a surface only because of this defect. Every other assertion in both tests stands.
- `.changeset/27532-upgrade-guide-surface-span.md`: `patch` on `@objectstack/spec`. `protocol-upgrade-guide.md` is in the package's `files[]` and is generated at publish, so the shipped bytes move.
- **Committed outputs regenerated: none exist.** `packages/spec/protocol-upgrade-guide.md` and `content/docs/protocol-upgrade/` are both gitignored and generated at publish or docs build. `docs/protocol-upgrade-guide.md` is a pointer stub that nothing generates. `git ls-files` lists no rendered guide.

## Tests

`packages/spec/scripts/upgrade-guide-surface-span.test.ts` (15 tests) has three layers:
- **The helper:** fence length, padding, refusals, and a round trip through the reader. A lit control shows the OLD single-backtick wrapping of every real marked surface reads as broken, so the reader can see a break.
- **The real entry set:** every semantic surface (516) and every conversion surface (109) round-trips through `codeSpan`/`readCodeSpan`. A new entry cannot bring the defect back, whatever backticks it carries.
- **The generated guide:** the REAL generator runs (`tsx build-upgrade-guide.ts --out`). Its bytes are read back span by span: each semantic line yields its surface verbatim followed by ` → `. Each conversion row is exactly four GFM cells, and the surface is one span filling its cell. A second lit control: the old row shape of a pipe-carrying surface splits into more than four cells, on a literal row and on every real pipe-carrying conversion.

Ablation on head `34de285ecf`, each leg through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, with anchor hit, blob change and restore all verified on disk. There is no `dist/` leg: the test imports `../src` and spawns the script source by relative path.
- Semantic site reverted to `` `${s.surface}` ``: 1 failed / 14 passed (`action-descriptor-is-async-retired` first). Restored, blob == HEAD.
- Conversion site reverted to main's row: 1 failed / 14 passed (`navigation-mode-overlay-values-removed`: 6 cells, not 4). Restored, blob == HEAD.
- Helper fence forced to one backtick: 5 failed / 10 passed. Restored, blob == HEAD.

## Acceptance notes

- Measured size of the defect: 183 of the 516 semantic surfaces carry a backtick, and all 183 broke under the old wrapping (markdown-it, rendered in memory). The card's "most" overstates it, but the fix and the pin are the same either way.
- Two independent renderers were checked against the fixed guide, beyond the pin's own CommonMark reader. remark with GFM (micromark, the docs site's parser) gave 516/516 semantic spans and 104/104 rendered conversion rows verbatim. markdown-it gave 516/516 semantic spans. An escaped pipe inside a table-cell code span renders as `|` in remark, markdown-it and marked alike.
- `summary` and the load-window cell are now pipe-escaped too, because `tableRow` escapes every cell. No current summary carries a pipe, so no byte moves there today.
